_about: What AIV takes from elsewhere, at which version, and where its new versions appear. check-dependencies.py of roccobot.github.io (.memo/scripts), run from this repo's root, compares the version in use (read where it is set: the version catalogue, the Gradle wrapper, the CSS of the feedback page, the font files) with the latest published; a newer one is read for what is worth bringing in before it is taken (Roccobot.md, 'Le dipendenze si seguono').
